node: Indium phosphide substrates and wafers for AI optical interconnects
summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around the InP substrate/wafer chokepoint. The clearest direct underfollowed exposure is AXTI, where InP substrates, China export licensing, and backlog are directly tied to the node. Downstream photonics/component names such as LITE and COHR validate demand but are now high-attention reference anchors rather than the main underfollowed lane. POET and FN are second-order discovery candidates: POET may reduce InP usage per optical engine through integration architecture, while Fabrinet may be an outsourced manufacturing/packaging gate exposed to optical module ramps and component availability. This is research-only universe expansion, not a trading recommendation.
